findings.title: Stale-cursor assertion assumes the first cursor widget is no longer selected or active
findings.message: firstCursor is the widget that was the active cursor in the initial projection. After the phases scroll, replace the source and move the selection, a pooled slot is reused by index. That same widget can legitimately become a selected or active cell in the new projection. The assertion then fails spuriously, or passes only by coincidence. It duplicates what assertGridUpdateStyles already checks per slot, so it adds flakiness and not coverage.
findings.suggestion: Drop this check. Or assert the leak only for the slot's current projection, for example by looking up the cell index of firstCursor and checking it against projection.Cells[i].Active and .Selected.
